build_emissions_graph: build a linear graph from an emissions vector with configurable time steps and num classes
build_ctc_graph: build a CTC graph from a target sequence and blank label for sequence modeling
test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward loss
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion by composing FAL, transitions, and emissions graphs then computing loss and gradients
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi path decoding by composing emissions and transitions graphs and extracting the best path
